name: Stakpak
description_en:
Stakpak is a DevOps agent for inspecting, deploying and maintaining infrastructure. It runs as a local binary with an interactive terminal mode and an Autopilot background mode; the product is aimed at operating applications rather than only suggesting source code.

Its automation can use model-provider access, infrastructure credentials and messaging integrations. A local process therefore does not by itself mean all inference and service traffic stays offline. Define the actual model, network and resource permissions before evaluating autonomous operation.
description_zh:
Stakpak 是检查、部署及维护基础设施的DevOps Agent，以本地二进制运行，提供交互终端及Autopilot后台模式，目标是运营应用而不只是建议源码。

自动化可使用模型提供商访问、基础设施凭据和消息集成，因此本地进程不自动意味着全部推理和服务流量离线。评估自主运行前需定义实际模型、网络和资源权限。

sections.title_en: Interactive work and background operations differ
sections.title_zh: 交互工作与后台运维不同
sections.en:
The homepage distinguishes the interactive terminal command, starting Autopilot and checking its status. Initialization discovers the stack and generates APPS.md, while a background service can persist across reboots. The documentation introduces rulebooks, sessions, reusable memory and channels for operational work. These are documented mechanisms, not proof that an example incident was resolved.

For a non-production pilot, give the agent read-only access to one test service, ask it to explain a failing health check and inspect its proposed command and session log. Expand to a reversible restart only after testing the permission policy and recovery path. No install, cloud access or autonomous action was performed in this research.
sections.zh:
首页区分交互终端命令、启动Autopilot及查看状态；初始化发现技术栈并生成APPS.md，后台服务可在重启后持续。文档介绍rulebook、会话、可复用记忆及运维消息渠道。这些是文档机制，不证明示例事故已被解决。

非生产试点可只读授权一个测试服务，让Agent解释失败健康检查，查看建议命令及会话日志；测试权限策略和恢复路径后再扩展到可逆重启。本文未安装、访问云资源或执行自主操作。

sections.title_zh: 检查策略及模型请求内容
sections.en:
The site describes Warden network policies, secret substitution and local audit logs. Those controls should be evaluated against the actual credential and tool scope, not taken as a guarantee that an agent cannot cause harm. The same site offers a model gateway and bring-your-own-key operation, so its broad “no data leaves” language needs deployment-specific clarification.

The linked stakpak/agent repository has an Apache2.0 license file. This verifies that upstream agent license, not every dependency, hosted service, model or generated output. The homepage also announces that Stakpak is joining Vercel; customer migration and future commercial terms were not established by that banner. No security audit or acquisition-contract review was performed.
sections.zh:
官网描述Warden网络策略、秘密替换及本地审计日志，应按实际凭据和工具范围评估，不能当作Agent绝不造成损害的保证。同站提供模型网关及自备密钥运行，因此宽泛的“数据不离开”文案需按部署澄清。

链接的stakpak/agent仓库含Apache2.0许可文件，核实的是该上游Agent许可，不涵盖全部依赖、托管服务、模型或生成产物。首页还公告Stakpak加入Vercel，但横幅不能确定客户迁移及未来商业条款。本文未做安全审计或收购合同审查。

sections.title_en: Managed apps, model credits and providers
sections.title_zh: 托管应用数、模型额度及提供商
sections.en:
The pricing page lists Hacker USD15/month for3 apps and USD10 credits, Builder45 for10 apps and35 credits, and Team450 for50 apps with350 shared credits and unlimited users. Builder and Team list USD5 per extra app/month; top-up fees are7% and10% respectively. Open-source use can bring provider keys or local models, which does not make external provider compute free.

An illustrative Builder account managing12 apps has a USD55 subscription/app subtotal before token overages or other charges. Included gateway credits are part of the stated plan, not an additional USD35 fee. Confirm credit expiry, top-up invoicing, app definitions and BYOK feature terms before purchase. Enterprise is custom. No checkout or token metering was tested.
sections.zh:
价格页列Hacker每月15美元、3应用和10美元额度；Builder月45、10应用和35额度；Team月450、50应用和350共享额度、不限用户。Builder和Team额外应用每个每月5美元，加购手续费分别7%和10%。开源使用可自备提供商密钥或本地模型，但不代表外部提供商计算免费。

假设Builder管理12应用，订阅／应用小计55美元，未含token超量等费用。已含网关额度属于套餐，不是另加35美元收费。购买前应确认额度过期、加购账单、应用定义及BYOK功能条款；Enterprise定制。本文未测试结账或token计量。
